title: Spotting Phishing Emails & Scam Calls
description: A friendly, no-jargon workshop on recognizing phishing emails, fake text messages, and scam phone calls. Bring your questions and, if you'd like, your own phone or laptop for hands-on practice.

title: Password Basics for Families
description: Learn simple, practical habits for creating strong passwords and using a password manager, explained in plain language. Great for grandparents and grandkids alike.
